 FRESNO, Calif. (FOX26) — WWE Monday Night Raw returned to the Save Mart Center in Fresno after 14 years.
 Monday Night RAW was at the Save Mart Center and streamed live on Netflix.
 The event featured Oba Femi, The Usos, Solo Sikoa, Women's World Champion Liv Morgan, and more.
 The last televised WWE show in Fresno was Friday Night SmackDown on December 18, 2018.
